independentContinuumMode.geometry: closed PEC vacuum cylinder, uniformly filled frozen-density collisionless plasma
independentContinuumMode.interpretation: All four components converge by greater than a factor of three for each doubled grid; finest component errors are below 0.001. This is a continuum mode benchmark, not a default-geometry pulse-interface convergence certificate.

independentDrudeTransient.interpretation: Second-order temporal convergence; electrical work partitions into drift kinetic storage and nonnegative collision heat.

issuesResolved.issue: Thermal contact lost tiny differences after adding a common absolute base temperature.
issuesResolved.resolution: Contact computes differences from retained increments and tests the implicit transfer.

issuesResolved.issue: A initialized finite plasma current reported zero maximum drift speed before a step.
issuesResolved.resolution: setFields initializes the historical maximum from the supplied current.

issuesResolved.issue: Hann 0.72/window value could be mistaken for full bandwidth.
issuesResolved.resolution: Metadata explicitly labels one-sided 3 dB half-width and full width 1.44/window.

issuesResolved.issue: At a mushy boundary, an absolute temperature could erase the tiny liquid-fraction change.
issuesResolved.resolution: The constitutive helper preserves liquidFractionChange from the retained temperature increment; cp*dT+L*df equals deposited specific energy under the declared synthetic enthalpy law.

readReview.drudeElimination: Correct midpoint alpha/epsilon0 contribution and impressed-source sign.
readReview.plasmaEnergy: J^2/(2 alpha) stores drift; nu J_mid^2/alpha dt heats the thermal store.
readReview.thermalEnergy: Sensible and latent cover heat use a single enthalpy store; contact adds equal/opposite energy. Deposition is not added again to total stored energy.
readReview.geometry: Fixed cover geometry is independent of melt fraction. Material and plasma volume fractions, currents and energy densities use declared full-cell normalization.
readReview.phase: Derived from real E history with exp(+i omega t) demodulation, peak amplitude convention, finite-window group delay and low-amplitude/reference masks.
readReview.grScope: Corrected GR references are separate from electromagnetic evolution and do not establish event horizons, metric identity or spacetime passage.

limitations: Frozen density and stationary ions; cold unmagnetized isotropic Drude current, not fluid/kinetic plasma dynamics.
Declared single-temperature plasma capacity assumes local electron/ion thermal equilibration; collision frequency is prescribed.
Synthetic cover cp, conductivity, latent heat and temperature interval; no measured material or astrophysical calibration.
Conductivity is frozen per substep and contact is first order; nonlinear thermal/contact convergence requires separate benchmarks.
Axisymmetry removes general azimuthal dynamics and the other polarization; 3D view is rotational reconstruction.
PEC outer boundaries plus an artificial electric sponge are not open radiative boundaries or a PML.
The mouth flux is signed net flux through the full inner-radius plane; reflected and incident components are not separated.
Finite-window phase of broadband or reflected/standing fields is a filter-dependent local timing diagnostic, not trajectory, topology or quantum coherence.
Benchmark checks are not observational black-hole validation, full numerical relativity, or NASA certification.
